description: AStriD DataHub - Daten aus der Fahrzeugsteuerung und Mobilfunkabdeckung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Codewerk GmbH. The available data sets contain data from the mFUND project AStriD – Autonomous Tram in the Depot. This data was recorded and stored by Codewerk GmbH's DataHub. Coverage: Codewerk GmbH. The portal shows the English title as "AStriD DataHub - Data from vehicle control and mobile phone coverage" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Codewerk GmbH. Its keywords include Betriebshof, DataHub, Mobilfunkabdeckung, Straßenbahn, Tram, autonom. The listing shows 2023-03-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
